author: Louis78Fourie
attribution: Photo: Louis78Fourie, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Departure_Terminal,_Kismayo_International_Airport,_Somalia.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted distance board over a 'DEPARTURE TREE' plank at Kismayo airport (the departure counterpart of the 'ARRIVAL TREE' sign, a different sign). 'DEPARTURE' has small dots between some letters on the plank. 'IED ENVIRONMENT AWARENESS / BEWARE IED THREATS' posters at the bottom are distractors. Alternative query: 'Kismayo Airport'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Departure Terminal, Kismayo International Airport, Somalia.jpg

author: Louis78Fourie
attribution: Photo: Louis78Fourie, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Arrival_lounge,_Kismayo_International_Airport,_Somalia.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted wooden plank tied to a tree that serves as the arrivals area at Kismayo airport; letter spacing is uneven ('ARR IVAL'). The 'SAFETY FIRST' banner on the wall behind is a distractor. Alternative query: 'Kismayo Airport'.
source_title: File:Arrival lounge, Kismayo International Airport, Somalia.jpg

author: Vincent van Zeijst
attribution: Photo: Vincent van Zeijst, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Somalia_(Somaliland),_Woqooyi_Galbeed,_Abaarso_(6).JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Weathered green village-name board sponsored by Telesom on the Hargeisa road at Abaarso (Somaliland). The arrow is a painted red arrow and '20Km' is painted in red. The 'The Reliable Choice' tagline is small and widely spaced. A taxi with a number plate and a man walking at right are incidental. Alternative query: 'Arabsiyo'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: wrcomms
attribution: Photo: wrcomms, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/134037448@N03/36839405522. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Telesom headquarters/shop in Hargeisa (Somaliland): green rooftop channel letters where the 'o' of Telesom is a yellow disc and 'company' follows with almost no gap; red 'XARUNTA TOTAL' on the fascia (Somali 'xarunta' = the centre). The green 'Taaj' remittance logo over the door (its tiny subtitle is not legible) and the side-wall repeat of the rooftop sign are distractors. People and vehicles are incidental.
source_title: Telesom shop and Zaad mobile money agent, Hargeisa, Somaliland

author: wgauthier
attribution: Photo: wgauthier, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/59442036@N08/51431545740. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted storefront in Berbera (Somaliland): red 'AL-IKHWA' with white outline over a black-on-yellow line. Painted drinks and rice-sack murals (RANI, Coca-Cola, Sprite) are advertising distractors; small stencilled numbers on the side wall and a tag on the door are not part of the sign.
